# Endorsements
We are honored to have gathered endorsements from the individuals listed below. If you would like to add your own endorsement, click on the link provided.
Thank you for your ongoing support!
- Contra Costa County Deputy District Attorneys' Association
- Supervisor Candace Andersen - Chair, Contra Costa County Board of Supervisors
- Councilmember Newell Arnerich - Danville Mayor
- Councilmember Mark Belotz - Danville Town Council
- Kathy Chiverton - Director, San Ramon Valley Mental Health Coalition | Board of Directors, Discovery Counseling Center of the San Ramon Valley | Board of Directors, Leadership San Ramon Valley | Steering Committee, San Ramon Valley Diversity Coalition
- Chief Paige Meyer - San Ramon Valley Fire Protection District (retired)
- Councilmember Renee Morgan - Danville Town Council
- Councilmember Karen Stepper - Danville Town Council
- Councilmember Robert Storer - Danville Vice Mayor
- Democratic Party of Contra Costa County
I have had the privilege of working with Denton for numerous years through the Tri-Valley Chiefs Association. Throughout that time, I have known him to be a dedicated professional with a strong commitment to public safety and serving the community. His leadership experience, integrity, and ability to work collaboratively make him well-equipped to serve on our Town Council. I believe Denton would be an outstanding addition and a valuable voice for our community.
Christopher Sherry
CHP Captain (retired)
I’m proud to support Denton Carlson for Danville Town Council. I’ve known Denton through his years of service to our community, and I respect his leadership, integrity and commitment to public safety.
Denton understands Danville and the San Ramon Valley, and he brings decades of experience working with residents, local government and law enforcement. I believe he will bring a thoughtful, practical and independent voice to the Town Council while working to preserve the quality of life that makes Danville such a special place.
Alan Kalin
COL, U.S. Army (Ret)
President Mount Diablo Cyclists (MountDiabloCyclists.org)
Co-Chair Danville Safety Advocates (BikeDanville.org)
2023 James Oberstar Award “Excellence in Bicycle Advocacy”
2023 Contra Costa County “Bike Champion of the Year”
2023 “California Outdoors Hall of Fame”
Alan Kalin
COL, U.S. Army (Ret)
I’m supporting Denton Carlson for Danville Town Council because he has the knowledge, experience, integrity and commitment to create the best possible future for our beloved town. Please join me in supporting Denton Carlson.
Eliza Rodrigues
Lawyer
Marc Silveira
Amanda Butland
Candidate for SRVUSD Board Area 1
Daniel Cabral
Assistant District Attorney, Retired
Angie Corritone
